login.title: Donyo i dul pa larem
login.welcome: Wa jolo in! Coye me doro jami ma ibi miini.
login.heroTitle: Dongo biacara ni me cato ngom ki dano weny ma i kelo
login.heroIntro: Kabedo acel me coyo nying luwil bot lugedo, gwoko lok ma mako dano ma i miini ki lubu gii nio wa i kare me yubu ot.

register.title: Co nying dano ma gubi bino i ceken manok
register.text: Cwal lawil ni ki yub ma cwiny gi tye iye.

protect.title: Gwok ma rwate
protect.text: Gin ma i miini bedo megi pi kare me gwoko ne, pi meno ngat mo pe twero gamo lawil acel-lu.

track.title: Lub rwom weny
track.text: Nen kit ma ngat acel acel tye kwede ki lok ma okato angec, cake i lok mukwongo nio wa i kare ma ki coyo.

handover.title: Cente i kare me booking
handover.text: Ka lawil ocoyo buk, gin ma ki lwongo ni lead ni ki miyo bot lagedo ki in ki coyo ni in aye ngat ma oyabo ne.

login.secure: Donyo maber - ngec pa luwil ni bedo ma pe ki ngeyo

signup.title: Coyo nying dano ma gi tiyo kacel
signup.intro: Yab akaunti ni me cako coyo nying ki gwoko dano ma ibi wilo.
signup.partnerName: Nying ngat ma tye ka tic kwede *
